Ömer Faruk Aksoy

Team Lead, AI & Data Engineer · Captain

An AI researcher and software developer building computer-vision, generative-media, educational, and space-data systems with the Ethosoft team.

About

AI systems for knowledge, creativity, and exploration.

Ömer Faruk Aksoy is an AI researcher, software developer, and the captain of Ethosoft. His work focuses on artificial intelligence, computer vision, generative media, educational technologies, and space data processing, with the goal of developing scalable AI systems that create real-world impact.

Driven by the vision of Türkiye's National Technology Initiative (Milli Teknoloji Hamlesi), he contributes to projects that strengthen domestic technological capabilities through open research and AI-driven innovation. His work spans AI-powered educational platforms, multimodal learning systems, computer-vision applications, and generative AI pipelines capable of producing advertisements, educational content, animations, narration, and videos from natural language.

Together with the Ethosoft team, he has developed solutions in education technology, AI-generated media, and planetary data processing while representing Türkiye in national and international technology competitions. His current interests include generative AI, multimodal systems, computer vision, autonomous content generation, synthetic media, and large-scale data-processing pipelines.

He continues to build AI technologies that make knowledge more accessible, accelerate creative production, and contribute to the growth of Türkiye's artificial-intelligence ecosystem.

Selected works

From educational media to lunar data.

Kara Tahta

AI-powered platform that automatically generates personalized educational videos, animations, narration, and learning experiences.

AI Advertisement Generation Pipeline

An end-to-end generative AI system that produces commercial advertisements from product images using image, video, voice, and animation models.

Bıdık

An AI learning companion designed to provide interactive and personalized educational support for children.

Lunar Dataset Collection Pipeline

Large-scale lunar datasets created by collecting, processing, and organizing planetary imagery for AI research.

Lunar Image Processing & Enhancement

Automated preprocessing and enhancement pipelines for lunar imagery, crater detection, and computer-vision applications.

Ethosoft contribution

Leading multidisciplinary delivery.

As captain, Ömer connects research direction with implementation across the team's educational, generative-media, computer-vision, and planetary-data initiatives. His role includes turning natural-language product ideas into modular pipelines, coordinating model and interface work, and helping prepare systems for demonstrations and competitions.

The profile's project descriptions are supplied by Ömer and describe the intended capabilities and development direction; individual systems may have different maturity levels and validation status.
